summary: JBDI Holdings, a Nasdaq-listed Singapore metal drum maker, filed a 6-K disclosing a September 14, 2026 stock purchase agreement to acquire all issued shares of Club Versante Group Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Canada-based restaurant group operating three venues, for $20,000,000. Consideration is payable solely via unsecured convertible promissory notes issued to sellers at closing, convertible at $1.00 per ordinary share with a 9.99% beneficial-ownership blocker and no fixed maturity. Closing conditions include Nasdaq approval; expected within one month. Watch dilution, note overhang, and Nasdaq clearance timing.
